description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a JSON IR (Intermediate Representation) dumper for a header checker tool, including functions for converting internal IR types to JSON and dumping module data.

classes.name: JsonIRDumper
classes.description: A class responsible for converting internal IR representations to JSON format and dumping them to a file.
